## Why it matters

The Programming Historian publishes peer-reviewed tutorials that introduce digital tools, workflows, and methods for research and teaching in the humanities.

Its multilingual lessons make it especially useful for self-study and course design, from beginner technical skills to more specialized digital approaches.
